description: P0/P1 hard-rule bindings. Every binding must point to executable release checks with both positive and negative coverage.

bindings.rule: Trigger words must match only at the first token boundary and must not match ff-apple or ff-fastlane.
positive_cases: valid ff-/ff-fast/ff-a route golden cases pass
negative_cases: ff-apple and ff-fastlane do not trigger fast/autonomous policies

bindings.rule: Project root state and project_guardrails status must decide whether flutter-forge can intervene.
positive_cases: empty_new and flutter_existing are accepted where appropriate
negative_cases: non_flutter is disabled and missing/stale guardrails are not treated as loaded

bindings.rule: Implementation writes before S4 must be blocked unless an explicit light-task exception applies.
positive_cases: confirmed S4 writes and safe sessionless light implementation writes are allowed
negative_cases: pre-S4 writes and light-task router/state/core writes are blocked

bindings.rule: Core task definition, current work unit, scope risk, plan conflict, and mode-exit locks must block unsafe progress.
positive_cases: valid S4 write and autonomous confirmation exemption are allowed
negative_cases: unconfirmed core definition, missing work unit, scope risk, plan conflict, and premature S6 exit are blocked

bindings.rule: Waiting state, attachment resume, and confirmation resume must persist and restore through ff_session.sh.
positive_cases: waiting state is persisted and matching replies resume the session
negative_cases: wrong or missing waiting-state fields fail session validation

bindings.rule: G17/G18 iteration control must produce executable decision hints, including marginal-stall exits.
positive_cases: passing scores can allow completion and normal low scores continue iteration
negative_cases: essential/pitfall failures force implementation and repeated low marginal improvement yields marginal_stall

bindings.rule: Visible workflow output must include entry, mode, phase, role, and completion logs in legal order.
positive_cases: light, medium, heavy, UI, and autonomous valid outputs pass
negative_cases: missing entry/completion, bad phase names, bare roles, and missing contracts fail

bindings.rule: ff-a may skip write-contract waiting but must keep high-risk interruption, validation, and final autonomous summary.
positive_cases: autonomous output with summary passes and autonomous write-contract exemption is allowed
negative_cases: missing autonomous startup or summary fails output validation

bindings.rule: Role checklist output must be structured and requirement_analyst must include quality_tier and Rubric items before allow.
negative_cases: allow without quality_tier or without Rubric items fails

bindings.rule: L3/L4 Rubric evaluation must declare verification_method, and unavailable visual or interaction evidence must be downgraded to code_review_only with an explicit evidence limitation.
positive_cases: L3/L4 code_review_only evaluation with explicit visual or interaction limitation passes
negative_cases: L3/L4 missing verification_method fails, and code_review_only without evidence limitation fails

bindings.rule: Active documentation links and active script references must stay synchronized with the repository.
positive_cases: active documentation references existing files and scripts
negative_cases: missing active links or script references fail docs sync

bindings.rule: Every P0/P1 hard-rule binding must declare source docs, runtime surface, release check files, and positive/negative coverage.
negative_cases: missing source, missing release check, missing needle, or missing positive/negative cases fails
